name: @sprite-foundry/townsfolk-hd
description: Townsfolk HD | 16 medieval NPC archetypes × 8 directions × 4 layers | high-fidelity 2.5D de-lit sprite pack (512px, engine-relightable)
author: mcp-tool-shop

scripts.verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./pack.json');let ok=true;let total=0;for(const v of p.variants){const base='assets/'+v.slug+'/';if(!fs.existsSync(base+'manifest.json')){console.error('MISSING manifest:',base);ok=false;continue}for(const l of p.layers){for(const d of p.directions){const f=base+l+'/'+d+'.png';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('MISSING:',f);ok=false}else{total++}}}}if(ok){console.log('All assets verified: '+total+' files across '+p.variants.length+' variants ('+p.layers.length+' layers x '+p.directions.length+' directions)')}else{process.exit(1)}"
